title: Grateful Dead Live at Indianapolis Sports and Music Center on 1984-06-30
source: Source Info: Master (FOB) Audience Cassette (11th row, DFC); 3 x Nakamichi CM700 mics > unknown deck > Dat > CDR; Transfer Info: CDR (EAC)> hard disk drive > Adobe Audition 3.0 > TLH flac16

ai_review.summary: Balanced Nak 700 audience tape captures the show well, but the performance feels sloppy—especially a disappointing second set.
ai_review.review: The recording, sourced from a Nakamichi 700 cassette, is praised for its proper speed and balanced tone, though it leans a bit bright. Musically the concert disappoints many listeners; the second set lacks tightness with a shaky transition into Playing in the Band, a saggy Terrapin Station, and a botched "rusty strings" line in Stella Blue, while Jerry's voice sounds hoarse.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is average to below‑average (3 ★) while the recording is solid (4 ★); weighted combination yields a mid‑range rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Balanced sound with correct tape speed; slightly bright but overall clear and listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set feels loose and poorly paced, with awkward transitions and lack of the usual tight, choogling energy.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His voice sounds hoarse throughout the show.
